title: Retro Sci-Fi Arcade Machines
description: A set of futuristic arcade gaming cabinets complete with iconic red bar stools. This 3D asset is ideal for enriching indoor environmental details such as entertainment zones, lounges, or public areas in sci-fi and modern-themed games.

title: Street Skull Skateboard
description: An urban-style skateboard featuring a classic skull graphic design on its black deck. This 3D asset is ideal for use as an urban street environment prop, room decoration, or a supporting element for a youthful and rebellious character.

title: Red Sport Coupe
description: A bright red sport coupe featuring elegant gold-finished wheel rims. This 3D asset is ideal for use as an urban environment vehicle prop, street racing car, or a decorative element in racing and modern-themed games.

title: Holographic Weapon Sight
description: A detailed 3D model of a tactical holographic weapon sight designed for modern firearms. The asset features a rugged black housing, integrated viewing window, adjustment controls, mounting base, and realistic mechanical detailing. Suitable for military, FPS, tactical, and realistic game environments.

title: Military Tactical Watch
description: A detailed 3D model of a military-style tactical wristwatch with a rugged design, analog dial, adjustable strap, and realistic mechanical details. Created for use as a realistic environmental or character accessory in games and 3D projects.
